role: LABELLER: ground truth for the S3 blind set. The recognizer never sees any of this.

draw.rule: tools/s3/thirdparty.py draw(blind_seed, n, exclude=the ids of draw.excluded): the candidates in draw.excluded (designs an earlier blind evaluation has seen, computed once when this freeze was written: freeze.spent_designs) are removed first; then the n remaining candidates with the lowest sha256(seed|id), then reserves in the same order

labeller.assembler: out/s3/replication/make_labels_r.py (a copy of out/s3/blind/make_labels.py adapted for replacements; helper, not frozen)

join.method: GDS property 61 on each std-cell reference = netlist instance name
